newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen A shares soar at noon on bank surge.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen A shares soar at noon on bank surge.

text.p: Shenzhen's A share index surged at midday on Friday, fuelled by sharp gains in market giant Shenzhen Development Bank which resumed trading today after a five-session suspension as punishment for irregulaties, brokers said.
The bullish A share market helped drag the foreign currency B share index up 0.46 points or 0.31 percent to 147.09 on turnover of HK$19 million, brokers said.
The A index jumped 17.61 points or 4.18 percent to 439.21, with turnover hitting 4.2 billion yuan compared with 5.1 billion yuan for the full Thursday session.
"The bank soared because news on its punishment had been factored into its share price," an analyst at China Guotai Securities said.
Last week, the Beijing securities authorities announced it would sack the bank's president He Yun after the bank was found to have used bank funds to trade its own shares.
The bank powered ahead 3.09 yuan to its 10 percent limit-up at 33.96 yuan on volume of 22 million shares worth 740 million yuan, making it the most actively traded stock.
"Investors scrambled to buy the bank shares due to confidence in the company's earnings prospects," an analyst at Shenzhen J&A Securities said.
The bank's dividend plan for 1996, which consists of a five-for-10 bonus share issue and a cash payout of 0.2 yuan per share, also stirred buying interest, brokers said.
Shenzhen Development Bank, China's only bank with a domestic exchange listing, is considered an A share leader because of its large capitalisation and robust earnings record.
The bank led a bull-run in Shenzhen's A share market between January and May this year before giving up some gains after official investigations began into its share trading.
On the B share market, China Bicycle put in the strongest performance, rising HK$0.07 or 2.30 percent to HK$3.12.
Brokers said they expected the B share market to score more gains in the afternoon if the A share advance does not lose steam.
